name: Bai Pu
bio: Bai Pu (白樸, courtesy name Taipu) was born in 1226 in Zhending (modern Hebei) and grew up in the household of the poet Yuan Haowen after the Jurchen Jin capital fell to the Mongols. Declining office under the new dynasty, he settled in Jinling (Nanjing), where he wrote songs and ci lyrics as well as plays. He is counted, with Guan Hanqing, Ma Zhiyuan and Zheng Guangzu, among the four great masters of Yuan drama.

Of some sixteen plays credited to him, only a few survive complete. The best known is Rain on the Wutong Trees (梧桐雨), on the love of the Tang emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei, while Rain on the Wall and Horse (牆頭馬上) is a lighter romantic comedy. His lyrics were collected as Tianlai ji (天籟集).
